_comment: Copy to cleanup-config.json next to the script. All keys are optional; missing keys fall back to the built-in defaults.
_launcherMatch: Substrings/regex matched against a cmd.exe window's command line OR its window title. These identify the launcher windows that may become orphaned.
_workerProcesses: If any process BELOW a launcher window has one of these names, the launcher is considered alive and is never touched.
_livenessPorts: The process listening on each of these ports, plus all of its ancestors, forms the keep-set that is never touched.
_graceSeconds: Never kill a launcher window younger than this (protects a service that is still starting up).
_logFile: Where the scan results are appended. Trimmed to the last 200 lines once it exceeds maxLogBytes.
